verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֗י וַתִּלְבַּ֤שׁ אֶסְתֵּר֙ מַלְכ֔וּת וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֞ד בַּחֲצַ֤ר בֵּית־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ הַפְּנִימִ֔ית נֹ֖כַח בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וְ֠הַמֶּלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁ֞ב עַל־ כִּסֵּ֤א מַלְכוּתוֹ֙ בְּבֵ֣ית הַמַּלְכ֔וּת נֹ֖כַח פֶּ֥תַח הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bay·yō·wm haš·šə·lî·šî wat·til·baš ’es·têr mal·ḵūṯ wat·ta·‘ă·mōḏ ba·ḥă·ṣar bêṯ- ham·me·leḵ hap·pə·nî·mîṯ nō·ḵaḥ bêṯ ham·me·leḵ wə·ham·me·leḵ yō·wō·šêḇ ‘al- kis·sê mal·ḵū·ṯōw bə·ḇêṯ ham·mal·ḵūṯ nō·ḵaḥ pe·ṯaḥ hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: On the third day Esther put on her royal robes and stood in the inner court of the palace . . . across from the king’s quarters The king was sitting on his royal throne in the royal courtroom facing the entrance

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ כִרְא֨וֹת הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת־ אֶסְתֵּ֣ר הַמַּלְכָּ֗ה עֹמֶ֙דֶת֙ בֶּֽחָצֵ֔ר נָשְׂאָ֥ה חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינָ֑יו וַיּ֨וֹשֶׁט הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ לְאֶסְתֵּ֗ר אֶת־ שַׁרְבִ֤יט הַזָּהָב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּיָד֔וֹ וַתִּקְרַ֣ב אֶסְתֵּ֔ר וַתִּגַּ֖ע בְּרֹ֥אשׁ הַשַּׁרְבִֽיט׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḵir·’ō·wṯ ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- ’es·têr ham·mal·kāh ‘ō·me·ḏeṯ be·ḥā·ṣêr nā·śə·’āh ḥên bə·‘ê·nāw way·yō·wō·šeṭ ham·me·leḵ lə·’es·têr ’eṯ- šar·ḇîṭ haz·zā·hāḇ ’ă·šer bə·yā·ḏōw wat·tiq·raḇ ’es·têr wat·tig·ga‘ bə·rōš haš·šar·ḇîṭ
verses.literal: As soon as the king saw Queen Esther standing in the court she found favor in his sight The king extended the gold scepter in his hand toward Esther and she approached and touched the tip of the scepter

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהּ֙ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ מַה־ לָּ֖ךְ אֶסְתֵּ֣ר הַמַּלְכָּ֑ה וּמַה־ בַּקָּשָׁתֵ֛ךְ עַד־ חֲצִ֥י הַמַּלְכ֖וּת וְיִנָּ֥תֵֽן לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lāh ham·me·leḵ mah- lāḵ ’es·têr ham·mal·kāh ū·mah- baq·qā·šā·ṯêḵ ‘aḏ- ḥă·ṣî ham·mal·ḵūṯ wə·yin·nā·ṯên lāḵ
verses.literal: What is it Queen Esther the king inquired What is your request Even up to half the kingdom it will be given to you

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֶסְתֵּ֔ר אִם־ עַל־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ ט֑וֹב יָב֨וֹא הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ וְהָמָן֙ הַיּ֔וֹם אֶל־ הַמִּשְׁתֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁר־ עָשִׂ֥יתִי לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer ’es·têr ’im- ‘al- ham·me·leḵ ṭō·wḇ yā·ḇō·w ham·me·leḵ wə·hā·mān hay·yō·wm ’el- ham·miš·teh ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śî·ṯî lōw
verses.literal: If it pleases the king . . . Esther replied may the king and Haman come today to the banquet I have prepared for the king

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ מַהֲרוּ֙ אֶת־ הָמָ֔ן לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת אֶת־ דְּבַ֣ר אֶסְתֵּ֑ר וַיָּבֹ֤א הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וְהָמָ֔ן אֶל־ הַמִּשְׁתֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁר־ עָשְׂתָ֥ה אֶסְתֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ ma·hă·rū ’eṯ- hā·mān la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- də·ḇar ’es·têr way·yā·ḇō ham·me·leḵ wə·hā·mān ’el- ham·miš·teh ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śə·ṯāh ’es·têr
verses.literal: Hurry commanded the king and bring Haman so we can do as Esther has requested So the king and Haman went to the banquet that Esther had prepared

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ לְאֶסְתֵּר֙ בְּמִשְׁתֵּ֣ה הַיַּ֔יִן מַה־ שְּׁאֵלָתֵ֖ךְ וְיִנָּ֣תֵֽן לָ֑ךְ וּמַה־ בַּקָּשָׁתֵ֛ךְ עַד־ חֲצִ֥י הַמַּלְכ֖וּת וְתֵעָֽשׂ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ lə·’es·têr bə·miš·têh hay·ya·yin mah- šə·’ê·lā·ṯêḵ wə·yin·nā·ṯên lāḵ ū·mah- baq·qā·šā·ṯêḵ ‘aḏ- ḥă·ṣî ham·mal·ḵūṯ wə·ṯê·‘āś
verses.literal: And as they drank their wine the king said to Esther What is your petition It will be given to you What is your request Even up to half the kingdom it will be fulfilled
Esther . . . replied This is my petition and my request

verses.original: אִם־ מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֜ן בְּעֵינֵ֣י הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וְאִם־ עַל־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ ט֔וֹב לָתֵת֙ אֶת־ שְׁאֵ֣לָתִ֔י וְלַעֲשׂ֖וֹת אֶת־ בַּקָּשָׁתִ֑י יָב֧וֹא הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ וְהָמָ֗ן אֶל־ הַמִּשְׁתֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֣ה לָהֶ֔ם וּמָחָ֥ר אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֖ה כִּדְבַ֥ר הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- mā·ṣā·ṯî ḥên bə·‘ê·nê ham·me·leḵ wə·’im- ‘al- ham·me·leḵ ṭō·wḇ lā·ṯêṯ ’eṯ- šə·’ê·lā·ṯî wə·la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- baq·qā·šā·ṯî yā·ḇō·w ham·me·leḵ wə·hā·mān ’el- ham·miš·teh ’ă·šer ’e·‘ĕ·śeh lā·hem ū·mā·ḥār ’e·‘ĕ·śeh kiḏ·ḇar ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: If I have found favor in the sight of the king and if it pleases the king . . . to grant my petition and fulfill my request may the king and Haman come tomorrow to the banquet I will prepare for them Then I will answer the king’s question

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֤א הָמָן֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא שָׂמֵ֖חַ וְט֣וֹב לֵ֑ב וְכִרְאוֹת֩ הָמָ֨ן אֶֽת־ מָרְדֳּכַ֜י בְּשַׁ֣עַר הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וְלֹא־ קָם֙ וְלֹא־ זָ֣ע מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וַיִּמָּלֵ֥א הָמָ֛ן עַֽל־ מָרְדֳּכַ֖י חֵמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê hā·mān bay·yō·wm ha·hū śā·mê·aḥ wə·ṭō·wḇ lêḇ wə·ḵir·’ō·wṯ hā·mān ’eṯ- mā·rə·do·ḵay bə·ša·‘ar ham·me·leḵ wə·lō- qām wə·lō- zā‘ mim·men·nū way·yim·mā·lê hā·mān ‘al- mā·rə·do·ḵay ḥê·māh
verses.literal: That day Haman went out full of joy and glad of heart At the king’s gate, however he saw Mordecai who did not rise . . . or tremble in fear at his presence And Haman was filled with rage toward Mordecai

verses.original: וַיִּתְאַפַּ֣ק הָמָ֔ן וַיָּב֖וֹא אֶל־ בֵּית֑וֹ וַיִּשְׁלַ֛ח וַיָּבֵ֥א אֶת־ אֹהֲבָ֖יו וְאֶת־ זֶ֥רֶשׁ אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·’ap·paq hā·mān way·yā·ḇō·w ’el- bê·ṯōw way·yiš·laḥ way·yā·ḇê ’eṯ- ’ō·hă·ḇāw wə·’eṯ- ze·reš ’iš·tōw
verses.literal: Nevertheless, Haman restrained himself and went . . . home And calling for . . . his friends and his wife Zeresh

verses.original: וַיְסַפֵּ֨ר לָהֶ֥ם הָמָ֛ן אֶת־ כְּב֥וֹד עָשְׁר֖וֹ וְרֹ֣ב בָּנָ֑יו וְאֵת֩ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֨ר גִּדְּל֤וֹ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וְאֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְּׂא֔וֹ עַל־ הַשָּׂרִ֖ים וְעַבְדֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·sap·pêr lā·hem hā·mān ’eṯ- kə·ḇō·wḏ ‘ā·šə·rōw wə·rōḇ bā·nāw wə·’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer gid·də·lōw ham·me·leḵ wə·’êṯ ’ă·šer niś·śə·’ōw ‘al- haś·śā·rîm wə·‘aḇ·ḏê ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Haman recounted to them his glorious wealth his many sons and all the ways the king - had honored and promoted him over the other officials and servants

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֮ הָמָן֒ אַ֣ף לֹא־ הֵבִיאָה֩ אֶסְתֵּ֨ר הַמַּלְכָּ֧ה עִם־ הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ אֶל־ הַמִּשְׁתֶּ֥ה אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֖תָה כִּ֣י אִם־ אוֹתִ֑י וְגַם־ לְמָחָ֛ר אֲנִ֥י קָֽרוּא־ לָ֖הּ עִם־ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hā·mān ’ap̄ lō- hê·ḇî·’āh ’es·têr ham·mal·kāh ‘im- ham·me·leḵ ’el- ham·miš·teh ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śā·ṯāh kî ’im- ’ō·w·ṯî wə·ḡam- lə·mā·ḥār ’ă·nî qā·rū- lāh ‘im- ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: What is more Haman added Queen Esther invited no one but me to join the king at the banquet she prepared and I am invited back tomorrow along with the king

verses.original: וְכָל־ זֶ֕ה אֵינֶ֥נּוּ שֹׁוֶ֖ה לִ֑י בְּכָל־ עֵ֗ת אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֤י רֹאֶה֙ אֶת־ מָרְדֳּכַ֣י הַיְּהוּדִ֔י יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּשַׁ֥עַר הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl zeh ’ê·nen·nū šō·weh lî bə·ḵāl ‘êṯ ’ă·šer ’ă·nî rō·’eh ’eṯ- mā·rə·do·ḵay hay·yə·hū·ḏî yō·wō·šêḇ bə·ša·‘ar ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Yet none . . . of this satisfies me as long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king’s gate

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר לוֹ֩ זֶ֨רֶשׁ אִשְׁתּ֜וֹ וְכָל־ אֹֽהֲבָ֗יו יַֽעֲשׂוּ־ עֵץ֮ גָּבֹ֣הַּ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּה֒ וּבַבֹּ֣קֶר׀ אֱמֹ֣ר לַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וְיִתְל֤וּ אֶֽת־ מָרְדֳּכַי֙ עָלָ֔יו וּבֹֽא־ עִם־ הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ אֶל הַמִּשְׁתֶּ֖ה שָׂמֵ֑חַ וַיִּיטַ֧ב הַדָּבָ֛ר לִפְנֵ֥י הָמָ֖ן וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָעֵֽץ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer lōw ze·reš ’iš·tōw wə·ḵāl ’ō·hă·ḇāw ya·‘ă·śū- ‘êṣ gā·ḇō·ah ḥă·miš·šîm ’am·māh ū·ḇab·bō·qer ’ĕ·mōr lam·me·leḵ wə·yiṯ·lū ’eṯ- mā·rə·do·ḵay ‘ā·lāw ū·ḇō- ‘im- ham·me·leḵ ʾɛl ham·miš·teh śā·mê·aḥ way·yî·ṭaḇ had·dā·ḇār lip̄·nê hā·mān way·ya·‘aś hā·‘êṣ
verses.literal: His wife Zeresh and all his friends told him Have them build a gallows fifty cubits high and ask the king in the morning to have Mordecai hanged on it Then go to the banquet with the king and enjoy yourself The advice . . . pleased Haman and he had the gallows constructed
